title: Contracts the district itself calls retroactive: the service start it states, and the meeting
question: Where the district asks the board to approve a contract after the work began, how long had the work been going?
finding: 10 of the 115 action items are titled retroactive; 6 state when services began, a median of 92 days and at most 223 days before the meeting. One later item corrects an earlier one: the retroactive Protiviti agreement approved on 2023-09-12 had stated a start of 1 May 2023; the amendment says the work ran from 2023-02-01.
how: Items whose subject contains "Retroactive". The service start is the date the page gives after "beginning on", or the corrected term a later amendment states; days = meeting date minus that start.
limits: The board’s policy (Board Policy 3312, cited on each page) allows a retroactive submission as an exception, and each page states the reason: a late budget load, a missed approval step, an urgent service for a pupil. The pages are the district’s own account. Whether the board approved each one is in the minutes, not on disk.
